title: Updated global warming potentials of inhaled halogenated anesthetics, isoflurane and sevoflurane from new temperature dependent OH-kinetics
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00061K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sara Espinosa, Francisco Martínez, María Antiñolo, Ole J. Nielsen, Elena Jiménez
This work shows a reduction with respect to current IPCC and WMO recommendations of the global warming potential for isoflurane and for sevoflurane at a time horizon of 100 years.
